epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Sub-50ms search latency on 1,697 documents with zero dropped queries
epics.tocConstraintRef: In-memory inverted index and faceted filter throughput
requirements: R1: Index and catalog all 1,697 institutional documents including RPD 2026/27, FOS, RUP curricula, GIA programs, and dissertation council regulations.
R2: Sub-millisecond full-text and token search over discipline titles, specialty codes, and metadata keywords.

R3: One-click faceted filtering by document type (Regulations, Orders, Procedures, Rules, Instructions, Protocols of PK, GEK, UMS, attestations) and by specialty (31.08.36 Epidemiology, 31.08.35 Infectious Diseases, 31.08.19 Pediatrics).
R4: Universal responsive mobile-first UI with bottom navigation bar (Assistant, Knowledge Base, Orders, Workload) and PWA manifest for home-screen installation.

slices.title: Define Search and Document Facet REST Contract
slices.jtbd: When implementing shared communication contracts for this epic, I want OpenAPI specifications for search and faceted querying, so that frontend and backend developers build against consistent schema interfaces.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for `/api/search` and `/api/documents/facets`,
When validating request schema with specialty codes ('31.08.36', '31.08.35', '31.08.19') and document types,
Then responses match strict JSON schema with pagination, highlighted fragments, and facet counts.
Given an invalid query payload,
When sent to `/api/search`,
Then the contract returns 422 Unprocessable Entity with deterministic validation error structures.
slices.tocConstraintRef: API contract ambiguity between web client and Python service
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema validation compliance in automated contract linters

slices.title: Implement High-Performance Inverted Index and Filter Engine
slices.jtbd: When implementing storage and query indexing for this epic, I want an in-memory tokenized index of the 1,697 normative documents, so that queries execute in under 10 milliseconds without external search daemons.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the catalog file `data/normative/corpus_catalog.json` containing 1,697 documents,
When the indexing service boots,
Then all records are parsed, tokenized, and indexed by discipline, code, and category in memory.
Given search queries with Russian morphology and abbreviations (e.g., 'РПД', 'ГИА', 'ГЭК'),
When querying the index,
Then search results return accurate matches with snippet extraction in under 10ms.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Memory footprint and tokenization efficiency on startup
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Query execution time < 10ms for 99th percentile across 1,697 records

slices.title: Implement Fast Search and Faceting REST Endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing backend endpoints for this epic, I want lightweight FastAPI routes for searching and filtering the normative catalog, so that the mobile and desktop web interface can query resources instantly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a running FastAPI application,
When a GET request is received at `/api/search?q=Педиатрия&type=Положения&specialty=31.08.19`,
Then the endpoint returns status 200 with matching documents and filter facet counts.
Given an empty search query with only facet filters,
When the client calls `/api/documents/filter`,
Then all documents matching the selected specialty and category are returned without error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero serialization errors and latency < 25ms end-to-end

slices.title: Implement Responsive Mobile-First Search and Bottom Nav UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing client-side presentation for this epic, I want an accessible responsive search interface with one-click facet chips, bottom navigation, and PWA manifest, so that residents and faculty enjoy instant mobile and desktop discovery.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user on a mobile viewport (375px width),
When viewing the application,
Then the bottom navigation bar displays four tabs ('Ассистент', 'База знаний', 'Приказы', 'Нагрузка') with WCAG 2.1 AA focus and contrast.
Given the search interface,
When the user taps on specialty or document type filter chips,
Then the document list filters dynamically in real-time without page reload.
Given a PWA installation prompt,
When the web app is loaded,
Then a valid `manifest.webmanifest` and service worker register for home screen installation.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Mobile viewport rendering and touch target ergonomics
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Lighthouse Accessibility score >= 98 and First Contentful Paint < 1.0s

slices.title: Verify Search Accuracy, Facet Filtering, and Responsive Journey Across Test Pyramid
slices.jtbd: When implementing verification for this epic, I want unit, integration, and E2E test suites covering index accuracy, API latency, and responsive mobile journeys, so that search defects are caught automatically.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for the tokenization and filter index,
When executed with test corpora,
Then term normalization, Russian stemming, and facet combinations pass with 100% assertion coverage.
Given integration tests against `/api/search` and `/api/documents/facets`,
When stress-tested with concurrent filter requests,
Then all responses return 200 OK within 50ms without data race conditions.
Given an end-to-end test in headless browser simulation,
When a user enters 'Инфекционные болезни', filters by '31.08.35', and clicks a document,
Then the correct normative document details are rendered on screen.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Automated CI test coverage across test pyramid
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero test failures and > 90% branch coverage on search modules

epics.title: Personal AI Regulatory Assistant & GOST Order Generator
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, instructor, or resident needs regulatory guidance or administrative drafts, I want an AI assistant grounded in institutional knowledge and a one-click GOST R 7.0.97-2016 .docx order generator, so that official administrative tasks are executed accurately in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% adherence to GOST R 7.0.97-2016 formatting and > 95% regulatory citation accuracy
epics.tocConstraintRef: LLM prompt synthesis and deterministic DOCX document compilation
requirements: R1: Regulatory AI assistant knowledge grounded in FGOS VO, academic year calendar, 3 mandatory stages of GIA, SanPiN, and candidate minimum requirements.
R2: Interactive instant consultation answering resident and faculty inquiries on practice hours, exam admission, commission members, and VAK publication rules.

R3: One-click project generation of official institutional orders (enrollment, GIA admission, scholarship allocation) in Microsoft Word (.docx) format conforming strictly to GOST R 7.0.97-2016 (Times New Roman 14pt, 30mm left / 15mm right margins, Rospotrebnadzor requisites).

slices.title: Define Assistant Prompt Context and Order Template Contract
slices.jtbd: When implementing shared interfaces for this epic, I want strict schemas for consultation prompts and GOST order generation parameters, so that frontend UI and backend generation engine operate in lockstep.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given OpenAPI schema for `/api/assistant/chat` and `/api/orders/generate`,
When client passes consultation queries or order parameters (type, student reference, commission members),
Then request payloads validate against JSON schema specifying mandatory GOST metadata fields.
Given an invalid order generation request,
When submitted without required template fields,
Then the server returns 400 Bad Request with field-level diagnostic messages.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero contract mismatch errors between frontend and backend

slices.title: Implement Regulatory Assistant Knowledge Context and Consultation Service
slices.jtbd: When implementing AI assistance for this epic, I want a grounded prompt orchestrator with institutional memory of FGOS VO, GIA stages, SanPiN, and VAK requirements, so that inquiries receive legally accurate, hallucination-free guidance.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an inquiry regarding GIA three-stage admission or practice hours,
When processed by the assistant consultation engine,
Then the generated response quotes applicable FGOS VO, SanPiN, or institutional regulation clauses without fabricated requirements.
Given a query regarding candidate exams or VAK publication thresholds,
When evaluated by the assistant service,
Then specific journal indexation requirements (VAK list, peer-reviewed standards) are precisely detailed in the output text.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Context window retrieval precision and citation grounding
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Citation hallucination rate < 1.0% in golden evaluation benchmark

slices.title: Implement GOST R 7.0.97-2016 Word Document (.docx) Generator
slices.jtbd: When implementing document generation for this epic, I want a Python DOCX compilation service producing institutional orders with Times New Roman 14pt, 30mm/15mm margins, and Rospotrebnadzor requisites, so that administrators receive official-ready files.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an order request for enrollment, GIA admission, or scholarship allocation,
When generated via `/api/orders/generate`,
Then the resulting .docx file strictly conforms to GOST R 7.0.97-2016 with 30mm left margin, 15mm right margin, and 14pt Times New Roman typography.
Given generated order files,
When opened with standard Microsoft Word or LibreOffice tools,
Then Rospotrebnadzor institution header requisites, preamble, numbering, and signature blocks render without visual or XML corruption.
slices.tocConstraintRef: OpenXML styling compliance and table/margin geometry precision
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate in automated OpenXML schema and geometry validation checks

slices.title: Implement Assistant Chat Dialog and Order Draft Generation UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing user interface components for this epic, I want an interactive chat window and order generation form accessible on mobile and desktop, so that staff can easily query regulatory topics and download generated order drafts.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user navigating to the 'Ассистент' or 'Приказы' tabs,
When entering questions into the chat box,
Then streaming responses display with markdown formatting, regulatory citations, and instant copy buttons.
Given the 'Приказы' generation screen,
When the user selects order type and enters parameters, then clicks 'Сформировать приказ',
Then progress is displayed, and the resulting `.docx` file downloads automatically to the user's device.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Mobile chat layout stability and file download handling
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero UI freezes during generation and 100% successful download initiation

slices.title: Verify AI Consultations and Document Format Compliance Across Test Pyramid
slices.jtbd: When implementing automated verification for this epic, I want comprehensive unit, integration, and E2E tests validating regulatory consultation responses and GOST .docx formatting, so that regressions are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for the GOST document generator,
When generating enrollment and GIA orders,
Then margin measurements (30mm/15mm), font families ('Times New Roman'), and font sizes (14pt) assert strictly true.
Given integration tests for `/api/assistant/chat` and `/api/orders/generate`,
When called with valid and boundary inputs,
Then API status codes and returned binary MIME types (`application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`) pass inspection.
Given an end-to-end browser test,
When requesting an order generation via the web form,
Then the downloaded file is verified for non-zero length and valid ZIP/OpenXML headers.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Automated DOCX file parsing and integration test harness
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test pass rate across the unit, integration, and UI test pyramid

epics.title: Faculty Teaching Workload Express Calculator
epics.jtbd: When a department head or faculty member plans pedagogical activities, I want an interactive express calculator computing annual hours and FTE rate against departmental norms (750-900 hrs/year) with instant overload/underload alerts, so that teaching loads are balanced and compliant with labor regulations.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% numerical calculation accuracy with real-time recalculation < 50ms
epics.tocConstraintRef: Workload formula accuracy and reactive state recalculation
requirements: R1: Interactive annual pedagogical workload computation accepting lecture hours, seminars, practical training, postgraduate supervision, and state examination board (GEK) participation.
R2: Instant full-time equivalent (FTE) rate calculation based on departmental norm bounds (750 to 900 hours/year).
R3: Real-time visual threshold warnings for workload overload (> 1.0 FTE or > norm ceiling) or underload (< 1.0 FTE or < norm floor) with clear numerical discrepancy indicators.

slices.title: Define Workload Calculation Model and Validation Rules
slices.jtbd: When implementing domain data models for this epic, I want Pydantic data schemas and calculation formulas for teaching load categories and FTE rates, so that mathematical logic is centralized and consistent.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given teaching workload input parameters (lectures, seminars, practice, supervision, GEK),
When calculated against departmental norms between 750 and 900 hours,
Then total hours, FTE fraction, and overload/underload status compute with exact floating-point precision.
Given negative hour inputs or invalid norm ranges,
When validated by the schema,
Then validation fails with descriptive field-level error messages.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Workload calculation schema and arithmetic accuracy
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero arithmetic drift and 100% validation coverage

slices.title: Implement Faculty Workload REST Service Endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing backend services for this epic, I want a calculation endpoint `/api/workload/calculate` evaluating submitted teaching hours, so that clients receive validated FTE breakdowns and status flags.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a POST request to `/api/workload/calculate` with valid hour categories,
When processed by the endpoint,
Then response returns 200 OK with total hours, calculated FTE rate, and overload/underload warnings.
Given boundary inputs where hours exactly equal 750 or 900,
When sent to the endpoint,
Then status indicates balanced workload with zero warning flags.

slices.title: Implement Interactive Workload Calculator Tab in Responsive UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing user-facing calculator views for this epic, I want an interactive mobile and desktop form with real-time recalculation, gauge meters, and alert badges, so that faculty immediately visualize their workload status.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the 'Нагрузка' tab in the application UI,
When user enters or adjusts hour values in lecture, seminar, practice, postgraduate, or GEK fields,
Then total hours and FTE rate recalculate immediately without submitting a page reload.
Given a calculated total exceeding the department ceiling (e.g. > 900 hrs),
When displayed on screen,
Then a high-contrast amber/red warning banner indicates overload with the excess hour differential.
Given a calculated total below the department floor (e.g. < 750 hrs),
When displayed on screen,
Then an informative warning indicates underload with the deficit hour count.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Reactive client state updates and accessible contrast indicators
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero UI lag (< 16ms frame budget) during input field changes

slices.title: Verify Workload Calculations and UI Reactive Indicators Across Test Pyramid
slices.jtbd: When implementing automated test suites for this epic, I want unit tests for formula logic, integration tests for API endpoints, and E2E tests for reactive UI warnings, so that calculation defects are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for the workload formula engine,
When tested across boundary norms (750h, 850h, 900h) and random load vectors,
Then calculated FTE values and overload boolean flags match expected mathematical truth.
Given integration tests against `/api/workload/calculate`,
When invalid payloads and edge cases are submitted,
Then HTTP response codes and error payloads strictly validate.
Given an end-to-end test in a browser session,
When typing 950 total hours into the workload form,
Then the overload badge dynamically appears with correct excess value.
slices.tocConstraintRef: End-to-end browser assertion of reactive form states
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test pass rate across unit, integration, and E2E suites

epics.title: Privacy, Data Protection & Accessibility Compliance
epics.jtbd: When deploying the platform for educational and clinical staff, I want data subject rights, local backup verification, and strict accessibility compliance, so that all legal and regulatory standards are fulfilled.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero real personal data exposure in external models and 100% cryptographic integrity on backups
epics.tocConstraintRef: De-identification tokenization gateway and 152-FZ compliance boundary
requirements: R1: Strict 152-FZ compliance ensuring real personal data (full names, passport numbers) are never transmitted to external neural network APIs.
R2: Anonymized synthetic avatar identity system with standard identifiers (ORD-XXXX for residents, ASP-XXXX for postgraduates, FAC-XXXX for faculty members) for all internal operations.
R3: Cryptographic local backup and verified restore mechanism for institutional catalog and session metadata ensuring data availability.
R4: Universal accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 Level AA) with visible keyboard focus, 4.5:1 text contrast, and labeled touch targets across all mobile and desktop screens.

slices.title: Implement 152-FZ Avatar De-Identification and Masking Tokenizer
slices.jtbd: When implementing data protection for this epic, I want an automated masking and pseudonymization engine converting student and faculty PII into synthetic avatars (ORD-XXXX, ASP-XXXX, FAC-XXXX), so that external LLMs never ingest identifying personal data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given input text containing personal names, passport numbers, or emails,
When processed by the de-identification sanitizer before external API dispatch,
Then real PII is replaced with deterministically mapped synthetic avatar IDs ('ORD-XXXX', 'ASP-XXXX', 'FAC-XXXX').
Given synthetic avatar payloads in `data/avatars/synthetic_avatars.json`,
When queried by the system,
Then avatar metadata resolves locally without exposing original real-world identity data.
slices.tocConstraintRef: PII detection regex/NER accuracy and pseudonymization lookup speed
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero unmasked personal data leakage (0.00 DPMO) across all outbound prompts

slices.title: Implement Security and Anonymization Gateway Middleware
slices.jtbd: When implementing request filtering for this epic, I want FastAPI middleware enforcing PII sanitization and avatar substitution on all assistant and order endpoints, so that 152-FZ compliance is structurally guaranteed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given any request sent to `/api/assistant/chat` or `/api/orders/generate`,
When passing through the security gateway middleware,
Then request bodies are inspected and sanitized to ensure zero unmasked PII reaches outbound handlers.
Given an administrative inspection request for avatar mappings,
When performed by unauthorized roles,
Then access is denied with 403 Forbidden.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Middleware processing overhead and security boundary enforcement
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero bypass vulnerabilities and middleware latency overhead < 5ms

slices.title: Integrate and Automate Encrypted Backup and Verified Restore Routine
slices.jtbd: When implementing disaster recovery for this epic, I want automated SQLite snapshot encryption and verified restoration testing via scripts/backup_restore.py, so that catalog and state data availability is mathematically verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an active database holding catalog and avatar state,
When `backup_database` runs,
Then an encrypted, HMAC-SHA256 authenticated snapshot is written with SHA-256 integrity tag.
Given an encrypted backup snapshot file,
When `restore_database` runs against a target destination,
Then HMAC integrity and SHA-256 checksums verify, and `PRAGMA integrity_check` returns 'ok'.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Cryptographic key derivation and backup restoration verification time
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% backup verification rate and zero integrity check failures

slices.title: Verify 152-FZ Anonymization, Backup Integrity, and WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance Across Test Pyramid
slices.jtbd: When verifying regulatory and privacy invariants for this epic, I want unit, integration, and UI accessibility tests covering avatar pseudonymization, backup restoration, and keyboard operability, so that compliance standards are maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for synthetic avatar generation and PII masking,
When supplied with strings containing Russian names and passport numbers,
Then zero PII leaks through and synthetic identifiers ('ORD-XXXX', etc.) are substituted correctly.
Given automated tests for `scripts/backup_restore.py` in `tests/test_backup_restore.py`,
When executing round-trip backup and restore with tampered and valid snapshots,
Then valid snapshots restore cleanly while tampered snapshots fail authentication with ValueError.
Given automated accessibility audit across all UI tabs,
When evaluated with axe-core or WCAG 2.1 AA linters,
Then zero color contrast, keyboard navigation, or form label violations occur.
slices.tocConstraintRef: End-to-end security and accessibility audit coverage in CI
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero accessibility violations and 100% automated privacy test pass rate
